sources.title: Pocket TTS: a high-quality TTS with voice cloning that runs on CPU
sources.snippet: These two changes make the modeling task much easier, allowing for a smaller model, but are deterministic and come with a limited set of voices. With Pocket TTS, we manage to bridge this gap and obtain a tiny model that runs on CPU without sacrificing any advantages of the larger models.
